Date: Wed, 4 Sep 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — demo next steps

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood — excited to see FleetOps exploring LLM-powered inference. I wanted to send a quick note with next steps so you have options:

• Self-serve: if you prefer, you can start with the sandbox and the onboarding checklist in the console.
• Live demo: if you want a walkthrough, we can do a 30-minute call focused on your use case and performance/cost tradeoffs.

If you'd like a demo, here’s a link to book a 30-minute slot that best fits your schedule: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

If you’re still evaluating internally, reply with the best times and I’ll loop in our SDR to set it up.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

--
Note: Attached to the technical invite we typically include a short one-pager. If you want it now I can send it over.

If those won’t work, happy to pick something next week morning PT.

Hi Sarah — Karthik here on Monica’s team, I handle demo scheduling and run the technical portion. Thanks for the times — those are helpful. I’m sharing a couple of options and a booking link so you can pick what’s easiest:

Proposed slots (PT):
• Thu 9/5 10:30–11:00am — 30 min overview + Q&A
• Fri 9/6 2:00–2:30pm — 30 min overview + engineer Q&A

Book here if one of those works: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

I’ve attached a one-pager with the serving runtime highlights and what to expect in the call: redwood-product-onepager.pdf (PDF).

If you want the engineer-focused agenda, we can push an extra 15 minutes and include a short checklist:
• Architecture & data flow (10 min)
• Latency/cost examples (10 min)
• Integration & security Qs (10 min)

Would you like me to send a calendar invite once you pick a slot, and include Joe?

—Karthik Iyer
SDR, Redwood Inference
